gamepad.reason: BitPlan does not expose gamepad input.

interactions.label: Pointer enters a primary or docs navigation link

source_evidence.observation: Hover classification uses primary header nav and Documentation-labelled docs nav, then plays nav-item-hover.

steps: Click Get started to unlock audio.
On /docs, hover the Introduction docs nav link.
browser_evidence.observation: Each newly entered nav link played navigation/nav-item-hover.mp3. Visible hover styling remained.

visual_alternative.description: Active and hovered nav links change background or foreground styling.

repetition.details: Fine pointer only, 150ms global hover budget, same target does not retrigger.

source_evidence.observation: Buttons, command items, and links outside primary/docs nav play item-hover.

browser_evidence.observation: Hovering Copy command played navigation/item-hover.mp3, distinct from header Docs hover.

visual_alternative.description: Ghost buttons show a muted hover background.

repetition.details: Same 150ms hover throttle as nav hover; nested movement inside the control does not retrigger.

interactions.label: Activate a primary button or CTA
triggers: Enter on a focused primary button

source_evidence.observation: Delegated click plays button-click-primary for data-variant default buttons.

steps: Click Get started in the homepage hero.
browser_evidence.observation: The click played buttons/button-click-primary.mp3 and navigated to /docs.

visual_alternative.description: The primary button uses the orange fill and the route changes.

repetition.details: One cue per click. Overlay openers skip the click cue.

interactions.label: Activate a ghost, outline, or secondary button

source_evidence.observation: Non-default, non-destructive button variants play button-click-secondary.

browser_evidence.observation: Played buttons/button-click-secondary.mp3, then the success toast cue.

visual_alternative.description: The copy icon swaps to a check and a success toast appears.

repetition.details: One click cue, then a separate toast success cue.

source_evidence.observation: toast.success is wrapped to play notification-success at the toast call, not the preceding click.
Copy command calls toast.success after the clipboard write resolves.

browser_evidence.observation: A Copied toast appeared and feedback/notification-success.mp3 played after the ghost click.

visual_alternative.description: Sonner renders a success toast with a check icon.

repetition.details: Each toast.success call plays once. Rapid copies retrigger because each copy is a new confirmation.

source_evidence.observation: A MutationObserver plays nav-menu-open when data-slot=sheet-content appears.
The header Sheet is the mobile menu. The sheet trigger click is skipped so only the open cue fires.

browser_evidence.observation: Only navigation/nav-menu-open.mp3 played. The sheet listed Docs, My drafts, and Sponsors.

visual_alternative.description: A left sheet titled BitPlan slides in with the site links.

repetition.details: The cue follows sheet-content count 0 to 1, not the hamburger click.

source_evidence.observation: The same observer plays nav-menu-close when sheet-content count drops.

steps: With the mobile menu open, click Close.
browser_evidence.observation: navigation/nav-menu-close.mp3 played and the sheet dismissed.

visual_alternative.description: The sheet unmounts and the page behind is interactive again.

repetition.details: One cue when the last sheet-content node leaves the DOM.

source_evidence.observation: CommandDialog is a Dialog. Opening it mounts data-slot=dialog-content.

browser_evidence.observation: The Search BitPlan dialog appeared and modals/modal-open.mp3 played.

visual_alternative.description: A dialog titled Search BitPlan is visible with the command input.

repetition.details: Repeating Cmd+K while open toggles closed rather than stacking open cues.

interactions.label: The user toggles light and dark theme

source_evidence.observation: The theme button plays toggle-on when leaving light and toggle-off when leaving dark, instead of a generic click.
The control is labelled Toggle theme and flips next-themes.

steps: Click Toggle theme from a light page.
browser_evidence.observation: states/toggle-on.mp3 played and the page switched to dark. The sun/moon icon swapped.

visual_alternative.description: The html.dark class and the sun/moon icon communicate the new theme without audio.

repetition.details: One cue per click. Keyboard D uses the same button path after the theme handler runs.

source_evidence.observation: notification-success plays after adopt, not when the Connect wallet button is pressed.

steps: This session had no live wallet prompt.
Unit tests in src/lib/wallet.test.ts cover waitForAuthentication.
Copy-command toast verified the same success slot audibly.
browser_evidence.observation: The success slot is the same file already heard from toast.success. Connect uses that slot only after authentication, not on click.

visual_alternative.description: Connect wallet disappears once isWalletConnected is true, or the user is sent to /drafts.

repetition.details: Cached connections and reconnectAuthenticatedWallet stay silent.

interactions.label: An already granted wallet is adopted on load

decision.reason: Reconnect is not a user action. Playing success on every page load would lie about a new sign-in.

source_evidence.observation: reconnectAuthenticatedWallet probes isAuthenticated and never calls playUiSound.

steps: Load the homepage with no click.
browser_evidence.observation: No audio played before the first gesture, including no success chime.

visual_alternative.description: Header shows Connect wallet or omits it based on connection state.

repetition.details: Silence on every load and coalesced reconnect.

interactions.label: Typing in the command palette search field

decision.reason: Per-keystroke audio fights the search field and screen readers.

source_evidence.observation: Delegated handlers only match links, buttons, and data-slot controls, not text inputs.

steps: Open the command palette with Meta+K.
browser_evidence.observation: Opening played modal-open. The input is a text field and is not classified as a click or hover target.

visual_alternative.description: Typed characters appear in the command input.

interactions.label: Sponsor checkout returns a signed transaction without broadcasting

decision.reason: noSend means nothing was broadcast. tx-sent is reserved for a real broadcast id.

source_evidence.observation: createAction sets acceptDelayedBroadcast false and noSend true. There is no playUiSound call.

browser_evidence.observation: No transactions/*.mp3 played. tx-sent remains an unused slot until a broadcast path exists.

visual_alternative.description: Sponsor slots and their purchase UI remain visible without relying on audio.

repetition.details: Signing is not treated as sent or confirmed.
